title: The star fort belt: how the bastion spread around the world
excerpt: I mapped 1,307 star forts in ink, from Palmanova to Hakodate. Only 19% can be dated, but the dates tell a clear story: the bastion did not creep out of Italy, it sailed, reaching India, Morocco and the Caribbean as early as Germany and England.
seo_description: 1,307 star forts on a hand-inked map: how the bastioned fortress spread from Italy to India, Africa, the Americas and Japan, 1500 to 1900.
header_alt: Title card on parchment reading 'The star fort belt' in black and red hand lettering, with a world map shading each country by its first dated star fort, the figures 1,307 star forts and 1535 to 1857, and the ink outlines of Palmanova, Naarden, Neuf-Brisach, Elvas and Goryokaku.
